label: Generator Device State
info:
Reads Generator Device State from inverter registers:
- 62: Today Gen Energy
- 83: Daily Operating Time
- 92+95: Total Gen Energy (low+high)
- 166: Gen Active Power
- 181: Gen Voltage
- 196: Gen Frequency

Note: Generator may not be connected. Values will be 0 or null.
